subject.title: feat: model-centric usage & spend view across providers (Scope B from #2257)

question: Should CodexBar ship a cross-provider model total that intentionally does not deduplicate overlapping provider sources, with exact-name matching and the proposed disclosure as its permanent Scope B contract?
rationale: The implementation choice determines whether displayed aggregate model totals are an acceptable insight feature or require provider-aware exclusions/canonicalization before release; this cannot be resolved mechanically from the code.

options.title: Approve the limited aggregate contract
options.body: Ship exact normalized-name token aggregation with prominent provider provenance and a clear non-deduplication disclosure, while deferring canonical aliases and exclusion controls.

options.title: Require stronger attribution first
options.body: Pause this Scope B PR until maintainers define provider-aware canonicalization or exclusion behavior that prevents overlapping source totals from being presented as a combined total.

recommendation.title: Approve the limited aggregate contract
recommendation.body: Ship exact normalized-name token aggregation with prominent provider provenance and a clear non-deduplication disclosure, while deferring canonical aliases and exclusion controls.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining choice is repository product direction for the Usage & Spend dashboard rather than a narrow implementation detail.
